measurementNotes: CPU-only fake device. Render calls are no-ops; the surface is 64x36. This measures compute dispatch, not browser frame rate or GL readbacks.
Current entries use full scene defaults and advertise the WebGL CPU backend; scenes can choose their own fallback settings.
Timing samples are two consecutive steady frames after startup and two settling frames; per-pipeline and total costs are independent medians, so they need not sum exactly.

Historical censer, falling-sand and ocean executions predate the backend brand and later CPU-specific Kit branches. Their costs describe the original full workload, not current browser fallback settings.
dispatches includes startup, warmup and measured frames. steadyPipelines contains per-frame measurements. unexecutedEntries are compiled optional paths not triggered by this scene driver.

scalarBenchmark.kernel: scalar hash, eight multiply/add/xor/shift rounds per invocation

fallingSandSimulation.note: Same cells/cave/rules/embers as the scene. Light/render passes omitted. Steady medians exclude prewarm. Fixed cost measured with zero workgroups over the same bindings.

f32Performance.note: CPU-only execution, current scene defaults and CPU backend brand. Median of 31 two-frame windows. Simulation advances through the windows, so compare the paired window counts. Small population differences change reserve invocation counts. Timing shares a machine with other agents.

fallingSandBeforeFieldProjection.note: Same cells/cave/rules/embers as the scene. Light/render passes omitted. Steady medians exclude prewarm. Fixed cost measured with zero workgroups over the same bindings.

compilationVerification.note: All33 examples compile on the live tree, including the new grid merge pipelines.

fallingSandBeforePersistentExecution.note: Same cells/cave/rules/embers as the scene. Light/render passes omitted. Steady medians exclude prewarm. Fixed cost measured with zero workgroups over the same bindings.

persistentExecutionPipelines.note: CPU-only fake execution after the live grid changed to GPU-targeted merge passes. Compare individual CPU kernels; totals include merge passes that run on the GPU in the real fallback.
